title: H2: premium launch attribution — every headless Planner launch persists route, reason, decision requested, evidence and cheaper steps tried plus the pinned policy version; scorecard --planner explains premium usage (invocations, context, output, cache, cost, top reasons) for headless and interactive sessions
spec:
Build on goal/T-0353 after H1 (T-0356: bus.policy_version, log_run fields). Handover sections 2 and 3. Evidence (scout T-0354): planner_runs._claim/_record_running (planner_runs.py:271-317) store kind, payload_key, attempts, account and jev but no reason, evidence or cheaper steps; goals.launch_planner re-reads pool.toml fresh on every call and nothing pins the effective config or prompt version to the run; scorecard.format_planner_runs_cell (scorecard.py:622-632) shows count and usd only; the interactive Planner's transcript tally (pool.tally_planner) is not broken down per session.
1. planner_runs: the claim record and the run row (bus.log_run) carry route (escalate | investigate | routine | none), reason (one short string), decision_requested (what the packet asks), evidence (list of short strings: task ids, hold reasons, failing ids), cheaper_steps (list), policy_version (bus.policy_version() at claim time) and prompt_hash (sha12 of the rendered decision prompt). When decision.py (H3a) is importable, take route/reason/evidence/cheaper_steps from its Route; until H3b wires it, default route escalate with reason "legacy:autonomous". reconcile() copies the pinned versions into the finished row; a pool.toml edit during a run does not change what the row says the run used.
2. planner_runs.premium_summary(days=7) -> dict: headless launches (count, by kind, by route, by reason top 5, mean and max input tokens, output tokens, cache read share, usd, gave_up count) from planner_runs.json plus run rows; interactive sessions from pool.tally_planner's per-transcript offsets: sessions count, tokens per session (in, out, cache read), day totals per account, labelled "interactive". Soft budget check: goals whose premium launches exceed [planner.routes].premium_launches_soft_per_goal (default 2 when the key is absent) are listed as exceptions with their reasons, never blocked.
3. cli: orchestrator scorecard --planner prints that summary as text (and --json); the existing --by goal table keeps its planner_runs cell but adds a route column (count per route).
Tests: tests/test_planner_runs.py::test_claim_persists_route_reason_evidence_and_versions, ::test_policy_edit_during_run_does_not_change_recorded_version, ::test_premium_summary_counts_routes_reasons_and_exceptions; tests/test_scorecard.py::test_scorecard_planner_text_and_json. Keep every existing test green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: orchestrator scorecard --planner on the fixture state prints invocation count, mean input, output, cache share, usd, top reasons and the interactive session rows, and marks soft-budget exceptions without blocking anything
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
